mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_code (user_id, code, status, expire_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{code}, #{status}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM identity_code WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM identity_code WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE identity_code SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE identity_code SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE identity_code SET use_count = use_count + 1, last_used_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_at > now()
mapper.select: UPDATE identity_code SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_at <= now() RETURNING *
